answer: The fix is ambient audio co-location proof with matched fingerprints: Two devices in the same room record ten seconds of ambient audio and submit matching fingerprints within a two-second window. A farm must place real microphones in real rooms per copy, and replayed audio fails the freshness check. Run the inlet before any answer is accepted. A lone agent pays it once; a ring pays it per ember, and the lagoon that matters is that the marginal cost of the next fake identity is always the full price.
